description_short: Draft one detection per step of a projected attack path, grounded in the telemetry each component actually has.
description_long: Reads adversary_path_projector exports - a path graph, a scenario seed, or a verified pair of both - and an optional flow map, and normalizes them into one context per attack step: a stable identity, a JSON pointer and origin for every field, flow-map lineage recorded rather than refused, completeness grades, controls, mitigations, ATT&CK v19.2 taxonomy, the actor_evidence / multistep_access assessment and the telemetry library join. Actions: validate_input (the full context pack) and digest (three readable lines per step) are deterministic and free; generate_detections drafts one detection per step, batched by path, at heavy tier, and returns JSON drafts marked draft_unvalidated - starting points for a detection engineer, not rules to deploy. A run with fewer valid drafts than steps fails with GENERATION_INCOMPLETE and saves its partial result. The context pack is re-derived on every run; the separate normalize_paths action (stage N4) was retired. Not auto-invocable because generate_detections costs heavy-tier calls.
author: Event Mill Contributors
